texts.0: SP, due to insufficient knowledge of the Flight Manual performance charts, did not produce the takeoff, climb, enroute, descent and landing computations required for the mission. The figures presented were read from the wrong chart and the fuel required for the route was understated by a margin that would not have supported the alternate. IP had to recompute all the data before the sortie could proceed.

The data set was completed only after IP identified each chart and each missing entry. texts.2: SP, due to an interpolation error between two chart lines, first computed an enroute fuel figure that did not agree with the leg times.
